information.name: João Alexandre
information.description: Full-Stack PHP Developer with 7+ years of professional experience (2018–present) building, maintaining, and improving business-oriented web applications. Specialized in PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, JavaScript, SQL, MySQL, responsive frontend development, backend APIs, database-driven systems, internal tools, automation, testing, and application deployment. Experienced in owning features end-to-end, learning unfamiliar technologies quickly, improving reliability and maintainability, and collaborating with technical and business stakeholders. Strong adaptability across backend and frontend stacks, including PHP/Laravel, CodeIgniter, JavaScript, C#, Python, and SQL. Open to remote or hybrid Full-Stack PHP, Laravel, Backend, and Web Developer opportunities.

soft_skills.description: Quickly learns unfamiliar technologies and codebases, including Python for backend application maintenance and C# for game-related projects.
Analyses complex issues, identifies root causes, and implements practical, maintainable solutions.
Evaluates technical and product trade-offs before selecting an implementation approach.
Takes features from requirements and design through implementation, testing, documentation, and deployment.
Explains technical work to developers, business teams, clients, and other stakeholders.

experiences.description: Full-stack development on the acingov web application, working on both backend and frontend features. Developing and maintaining business-oriented web applications using PHP, CodeIgniter, JavaScript, SQL, and related web technologies. Contributing across backend APIs, database design, frontend interfaces, and application support.

Designed and developed a full-featured Laravel web application for vehicle requisition and internal fleet management. Automated workflows, centralized operational data, and improved asset tracking. Developed a procurement and purchasing management tool in parallel, focusing on scalability, security, maintainability, and administrative usability.

Developed and continuously improved web applications used by local councils and public-sector organizations. Implemented features across the full stack and contributed to application performance, reliability, usability, and maintainability improvements using PHP, Laravel, Yii, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, and CSS.

Developed new consulting and data-driven web pages using native HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. Refactored frontend code to improve readability, performance, and long-term maintainability. Implemented search and filtering functionality for data tables and improved how users consulted information. Supported backend development by using Python to execute SQL queries and return JSON data to frontend components. Created technical documentation for client-facing web pages.

Contributed to the development of an internal Drupal website for EDP to manage and present corporate news. Developed and maintained SharePoint pages integrated with Microsoft Teams to support an internal virtual community. Created multimedia content and onboarding materials. Implemented automated test scenarios using Behat, performed manual testing, updated technical documentation in Confluence, and prepared monthly stakeholder presentations.

Developed and maintained internal web applications used in production environments. Implemented features, improved existing software, and responded to application incidents. Configured a Windows server environment, including XAMPP, and improved deployment workflows using Git and SourceTree. Delivered training sessions and technical presentations for development and business application teams. Worked with PHP frameworks, JavaScript, SQL Server, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and Git.

Completed an Erasmus internship developing new functionality and maintaining internal administrative web applications and public-facing web platforms. Worked with Yii, Behat, and Twig while gaining experience in an international development environment.

Completed a software development internship and gained practical experience with CakePHP, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery, and NetBeans. Strong performance during the internship led to a full-time employment offer after completing the course.

education.description: Four-year technical secondary education program focused on software development, programming, databases, and web technologies. Studied Java, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and SQLite. Completed a final project consisting of a game developed with C# scripts.
